## 406739865b43

**Issue found: the declared override domain is not executable and includes
invalid training fixtures.** `AXES["n_decoys"]` declares `0..5`, but the
reproducible call

```python
generate(0, 0, difficulty="medium", n_decoys=0)
```

raises `ValueError: draw_int('n_decoys'): override 0 outside [1, 3]`. The
source-bound override gate reports 20,522 findings across 105,750 draws and
52,650 undeclared multi-axis rejections. The defect linter also reports that
`no_marker_in_row0`, `no_matching_body`, and `multiple_matching_bodies` are in
the ordinary valid texture domain even though `self_check` rejects them, and
all four helpful textures are dead aliases. Evidence is retained under
`checks/audit/406739865b43/`.

A 9,000-draw default census found no self-check failure, so this is specifically
a public-control and data-selection defect rather than a claim that ordinary
default generation always fails. An exporter sampling declared overrides can
nevertheless crash or materialize invalid lessons. The generator also lacks its
required `RULE_HASH` pin (`c69934b21e7a` according to defect lint). A repair
should collapse the axes to observable semantic controls, remove negative
fixtures from the ordinary domain, and align declared ranges with every
band. No source change was made because this was a findings-only audit target.
